<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the Peterson reaction: in the forward direction it converts a β‑hydroxy‑silane to an alkene, breaking a C–Si bond and a C–O bond and forming a C=C double bond. In retrosynthesis we need the reverse: an alkene → carbonyl (ketone or aldehyde) + trimethylsilyl group. Therefore the template should have functional_groups_broken = ["alkene"] and functional_groups_formed = ["ketone","trimethylsilyl"]. We'll search the template catalog with these criteria.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["alkene"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ketone", "trimethylsilyl"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
